title: The wire: mcp types
description: Part of the source of every type on the wire (#1135, #5380): one file per domain in Packages/Wire/schema. A $ref to another file names it (core.schema.json#/definitions/JSONValue); scripts/wire.sh gen reads them all.

CatalogApproval.description: An approval of an MCP server or skill (#2019, M5): for a group, or for one person.

CatalogApprovalList.description: governance/approvals (#2019, M5), an admin's: every approval, by item.

CatalogAsk.description: governance/request (#2019, M5): a person asks for an MCP server or skill, with why.

CatalogDecide.description: governance/decide (#2019, M5), an admin's: approve or refuse a request. Approved with a group, the approval holds for each of its members; with none, for the person who asked.

CatalogItem.description: One MCP server or skill a machine has from a catalogue (#2019, M5): its name, the registry name or catalogue it came from, and its version (a server's version, a skill's commit).

CatalogPerson.description: A person in the catalogue's rows: their id and name.

CatalogRequest.description: A request for an MCP server or skill (#2019, M5). Approved for a group, it is approved at once for every member who asks again.

CatalogRequestList.description: governance/requests (#2019, M5): every request waiting to an admin, and to anyone their own of the last 30 days, oldest first.

CatalogRevoke.description: governance/revoke (#2019, M5), an admin's: take back one approval, for a group or for a person.

CatalogUseRow.description: One item at one version in governance/usage: on how many machines, and whose (at most 50 people named).

DocsList.description: docs/list (#3319): a page of docs, the last updated first. sources are the sources it looked at, each with its state: one that failed or is not mapped is named here, and the docs of the others still come. cursor is the next page, absent at the end.

DocsListRequest.description: docs/list (#3319): the docs of every folder on this machine and of their docs connectors, or of one folder, or of one source (a DocsSource id). A connector lists its map's recent tool, else its search for nothing. limit is 1 to 500, 200 when not said; cursor is the last page's.

DocsMatch.description: One place a search found in a doc: its line (1 is the first) and the line, cut short, for a folder doc; a snippet only for a connector doc.

DocsReadRequest.description: docs/read (#3319): a doc by its ref, lines from to to (1 is the first; both included). Absent from is 1; absent to reads as far as the read's limits allow.

DocsReading.description: docs/read (#3319): the doc's Markdown from line from to line to, and its total lines. next is the from of the next read when this one was cut short (by to, or by the line or byte limit), absent at the end. A connector doc is its read tool's answer turned into Markdown.

DocsSearch.description: docs/search (#3319): the docs that match, the most matches first. sources are the sources it searched, each with its state: one that failed is named, and the results of the others still come.

DocsSearchRequest.description: docs/search (#3319): the words to find, in every source or in sources (DocsSource ids). A folder doc matches when a line has the words, in any case; a connector doc when its map's search tool finds it. limit is 1 to 100 docs, 20 when not said.

DocsSearchResult.description: A doc that docs/search found, with its matches (at most 5).

DocsServer.description: One docs connector in the Docs slot (#3307): its name in mcp.json, and what its one real search found.

proof.description: The first doc the search found. Absent when it found none, or did not search.

DocsServerState.description: noMap: no agent has written a map of its search and read tools yet. notRead: mapped, not searched yet. read: its one search worked. failed: the search did not work; message says why.

DocsSource.description: Where docs come from (#3319): a folder, or a docs connector in a folder's Docs slot. id is the folder's path, or mcp:<server name> for a connector. name is the folder's name or the connector's. folder is the folder (for a connector, the first folder whose mcp.json reaches it). message says why, when state is failed.

DocsSourceKind.description: folder: a folder's own *.md files. connector: a docs connector, through its map in .agents/docs-maps.json.

DocsSourceState.description: read: it answered. notMapped: a docs connector with no map of its search and read tools yet (the map-a-docs-server skill writes one). failed: it did not answer; message says why.

MCPLevels.description: The five levels a connector reaches (#1428): tools, events and views from what the server declares, workflows when a ready-made workflow names one of its events, tested when it was tested on a real account.

needsApproval.description: Ask before use (#4014): kept sealed on this machine, never in secrets.env, and a person approves each use (#4015). Left out is off. From the agent role it is always on.

MCPSetToolLevelRequest.description: Sets the level of one tool of a connector, or of all its tools that write, in the destination's layer: yours for personal, the folder's .agents/policy.json for a folder (#4099).

tool.description: The tool's name. Absent: the switch for every tool that writes.

level.description: Absent: the layer sets nothing for it, and the default applies.

MCPToolRow.description: One tool of a connector, as tools/list gave it, with its level (#4099).

writes.description: Its annotations do not say it is read only (readOnlyHint), or say it is destructive (destructiveHint).

level.description: The level in force: the tightest of every layer, or the default (ask for a tool that writes, allow for one that only reads).

own.description: What the destination's layer sets for this tool itself. Absent: nothing.

cap.description: The tightest level of the layers above the destination's; a menu dims what is looser.

capLine.description: For example "Your policy: at most Ask".

writes.description: The destination layer's switch for every tool that writes. Absent: not set.

problem.description: Why there is no list of tools: the connector has not answered a check yet, or did not answer.

MachineCatalog.description: governance/report (#2019, M5): the MCP servers and skills a machine has from a catalogue, personal and in its folders, at most 500. Sent at start and each hour; each replaces the last.

ManagedPersona.description: A persona added from a marketplace (#3665): its file in .agents/personas, where it came from, and whether it has an update.

edited.description: The file no longer has the blob SHA it was added with.

keywords.description: The front matter's `keywords:` (#4559): the words in a first prompt that make Auto pick this persona. Left out when the file names none; then its name and description are the words.

PersonaPreview.description: A persona file fetched at one commit, shown whole before it is added (#3665).

PersonaSettingChange.description: A setting an update changes that the person is warned about: runtime or permission-mode.

installed.description: The file as it is now, for the diff.

PolicyMarketplaces.description: The marketplaces a policy allows (#998), by the ids #687 gives them, and whether an MCP server added by hand is allowed.

app.description: The app's own, sent to every agent.

runtimeOnly.description: Set up in one runtime's own config and nowhere else.

files.description: Its files, relative to its folder, for the detail's tree: at most 40.

clash.description: The other copy of a skill of this name, left where it was.

managed.description: Where a lock says it came from (059); none for the person's own.
